sources.note: Main website for MedOne Healthcare Partners. Positions as a primary care and hospital medicine practice in Columbus, OH. No mention of OneConnect or EHR software on the homepage — focuses on clinical services.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists OneConnect Version 0 certification details, 24 certified criteria, third-party dependencies (RXNT, EMR Direct, Medline Plus Connect), cost disclosures including PCC integration fees, and e-prescribing setup fees.
Describes MedOne's clinical services: hospital medicine, post-acute care across ~150 facilities, primary care, transitional care. No mention of OneConnect as a product.

Company history: founded 2000 at OhioHealth Riverside Methodist Hospital. Over 100 physicians, 75+ APCs, 40+ admin staff. 4 acute hospital systems, 4 LTACH partners, 150 SNF/ALF/ILF facilities. Independent, physician-led.

Website for MedOne Systems LLC, the software entity founded by Dr. Joseph Mack in 2012. Develops BOLT clinical software. Site is Wix-based and content-thin (mostly renders via JavaScript). BOLT described as EHR enhancement/overlay tool.

BOLT Clinical product page. Primarily testimonials from physicians praising speed and usability. One surgeon learned it in less than a day. Providers report finishing hours earlier. Limited technical feature details.
Alternative BOLT Clinical page. Wix-rendered, no readable content extracted.
OneConnect web application portal. JavaScript-rendered app, no content visible without authentication. Confirms OneConnect is a cloud-based web application.
ZoomInfo profile for MedOne Systems LLC. Reports ~$3M annual revenue. Based in Marietta, OH. Describes BOLT as enhancing existing enterprise EHRs.
Glassdoor employee reviews for MedOne Hospital Physicians. Only 6 reviews, employee-focused. No software product reviews found on G2, KLAS, or Capterra — product is too niche/internal.
LinkedIn page confirming MedOne as largest hospital medicine practice in central Ohio, 160+ physicians and APCs.
Crunchbase listing for MedOne Systems. Founded 2012, develops BOLT. Privately held.
